video_title: Draymond Green Recreates 'Inside The NBA' + Knicks-Spurs Game 4 Fallout

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on Victor Wembanyama's potential suspension
quotes.excerpt: I'm not one that wants to see series decided by suspensions. That's not good for anyone.
quotes.quote: I'm not one that wants to see series decided by suspensions. That's not good for anyone. It leaves a lot of questions, a lot of what-ifs. So I don't enjoy that. I will say he's been shown a lot of grace. He probably should be suspended at some point, or have been already. He's been shown a lot of grace, but I agree with the grace. We want to see Victor Wembanyama in the San Antonio Spurs versus the New York Knicks.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green's take on Victor Wembanyama's flagrant foul
quotes.excerpt: I disagree. It was a flagrant foul. However, who wants to watch the NBA Finals with Victor Wembanyama?
quotes.quote: I disagree. It was a flagrant foul. However, who wants to watch the NBA Finals with Victor Wembanyama out in the San Antonio Spurs play? Nobody. So that's a business decision, and I'm sorry to tell you all. I know I probably should be like, 'Man, that's bullshit, he shouldn't,' but that's the right decision.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on Josh Hart's missed plays
quotes.excerpt: Josh Hart and Jalen Brunson, they have a lot of fun in press conferences, but that was coming to an end.
quotes.quote: Josh Hart and Jalen Brunson, they have a lot of fun in press conferences, but that was coming to an end, unless they went on to win the series anyway if they lost that game. But man, that was a bad moment for Josh Hart. Josh Hart always finishes in transition and Josh Hart always does the right thing, and he missed both of them.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on Dylan Harper's rookie performance
quotes.excerpt: Dylan Harper continues to show how special he truly is. So that's who I would have to say.
quotes.quote: Dylan Harper continues to show how special he truly is. So that's who I would have to say is the most surprising, stepping up the way he's stepping up as a rookie. I'd have to say Dylan Harper.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on Jeremy Sochan's role in the series
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks were searching for anything, so it was also like, 'We got this guy who's practiced against Wembanyama.'
quotes.quote: The Knicks were searching for anything, so it was also like, 'We got this guy who's practiced against Wembanyama since he came into the league. Let's see if he can get out there, change the pace, mix it up a little bit.' Maybe he get into it with Wembanyama and fuck him up, who knows. But you just want to throw a different look out there because great players figure things out after a while.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on OG Anunoby's Finals MVP potential
quotes.excerpt: I do think OG Anunoby has been the most consistent, and he's averaging 24, 25 points in this series.
quotes.quote: I do think OG Anunoby has been the most consistent, and he's averaging 24, 25 points in this series. I do think, and may make big plays down the stretch, I do think as of right now, he's the Finals MVP. Jalen Brunson played great last night. One more great game from Jalen Brunson, it could be Jalen Brunson though.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on Karl-Anthony Towns' defensive play
quotes.excerpt: The reason people aren't talking about it is because OG Anunoby had the defensive stop and the tip-in.
quotes.quote: The reason people aren't talking about it is because OG Anunoby had the defensive stop and the tip-in. And so that's the play that's going to draw all of the praise from everyone. But if you're a basketball purist or a teammate or a coach, you know how important tipping that inbound pass was for Karl-Anthony Towns to get a finger on there and stop that alley-oop from going in.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on Stefan Castle's playing style
quotes.excerpt: I don't see a Russell Westbrook trajectory for Stefan Castle. I think they're two completely different players.
quotes.quote: I don't see a Russell Westbrook trajectory for Stefan Castle. I think they're two completely different players. Stefan is more pace, Russell is more force downhill. Both get to the rim, but in different ways. So no, I don't see that trajectory.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green's advice for the Knicks being up 3-1
quotes.excerpt: Don't read all the things that say you're up 3-1, it's over. Finish your breakfast.
quotes.quote: Don't read all the things that say you're up 3-1, it's over. Finish your breakfast. And more importantly, from a pride standpoint, put together a great game. If you're the New York Knicks, you're like, 'We're up 3-1, we still haven't played a great game. Let's make our last game our best game.'

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the Spurs' chances of a comeback
quotes.excerpt: The only thing you can tell yourself to regain belief is that somebody at least came from down 3-1.
quotes.quote: The only thing you can tell yourself to regain belief is that somebody at least came from down 3-1 in the Finals before, because I'm sorry to tell you, the more than likely, this one's over, my friend.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on which players' careers are most altered
quotes.excerpt: They win this series, King of New York forever. OG Anunoby, Karl-Anthony Towns, Mike Brown.
quotes.quote: They win this series, King of New York forever. OG Anunoby, Karl-Anthony Towns, Mike Brown. Those are the people that will be impacted more by this series because they bring a championship to New York City. The love they're going to get is insanity.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green's dream 'Inside the NBA' lineup
quotes.excerpt: I think Kevin Durant. You'll see some asinine statements from Kevin Durant. You know why? Because he's a lot like Shaquille O'Neal.
quotes.quote: I think Kevin Durant. You'll see some asinine statements from Kevin Durant. You know why? Because he's a lot like Shaquille O'Neal, the way you see the game. No one else can even begin to think like that because you're seven feet and you move the way you do. It's a lot like Shaquille O'Neal. Sometimes Shaquille O'Neal be like, 'Well, you just got to go do it.' And Kevin Durant be like, 'No, Shaquille O'Neal, we can't just go do it, you can.' Kevin Durant is a lot like that. I would say Kevin Durant, Anthony Edwards, if Anthony Edwards was retired, that would be fun, entertaining. That'd be a good group. I'll say those two. Stephen Curry, Stephen Curry has a brilliant basketball mind and Stephen Curry is funny.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.excerpt: DeAndre Hulett, Terrence Roberson, Romar Smith, Corey Hightower, to name a few. Those guys were insane.
quotes.quote: DeAndre Hulett, Terrence Roberson, Romar Smith, Corey Hightower, to name a few. Those guys were insane.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on which player skill he would steal
quotes.excerpt: And of course, it's Stephen Curry's shooting. He's the greatest shooter ever. If I could steal that, good riddance.
quotes.quote: And of course, it's Stephen Curry's shooting. He's the greatest shooter ever. If I could steal that, good riddance. I'd take that any day. Stephen Curry's shooting, for sure. No questions asked.
